title: SellPlugin
description: This plugin adds a simple /sell command and awards money using "/eco take Player Amount", meaning it works with more than just Vault. All prices can be easily edited in the config.yml.
body:
# SellPlugin

**SellPlugin** is a simple and customizable selling system for Minecraft servers.

Players can use the **/sell** command to open an intuitive GUI where they can place the items they want to sell. Once the sale is confirmed, the plugin automatically rewards the player with money using a configurable command instead of relying on Vault.

By default, SellPlugin uses:

 /eco give <player> <amount>

This allows compatibility with many economy plugins and money systems that support custom economy commands.

**Features**

-  Easy-to-use selling GUI (/sell)
- Sell items directly through an inventory interface
- No Vault dependency required
- Uses configurable reward commands (e.g. /eco give)
- Compatible with many economy systems
- Fully customizable item prices in config.yml
- Simple setup and lightweight performance
- Supports Minecraft 1.21.8

**Configuration**

All item prices can be edited in the `config.yml`, allowing server owners to easily balance their economy and customize the selling values to fit their server.

**Commands**

 /sell — Opens the selling GUI.

Perfect for survival, economy, and RPG servers that need a flexible item-selling system without requiring Vault.

**Full config.yml**

<details>
<summary>config.yml</summary>
